tooltip.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.gate.en: Once the wind trusts you, right-click a lit Nether portal to open a Gate to Hoanna (%s MRU)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.gate.zh: 风肯回应你以后，右键点燃的下界传送门，花 %s MRU 打开海纳尔之门

message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.not_.en: Light the Nether portal first: the tablet can only change a lit one
message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.not_.zh: 先把下界传送门点燃：石板只能改变点燃的门

message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.no_m.en: Not enough MRU: opening the gate takes %s MRU
message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.no_m.zh: MRU 不够：打开海纳尔之门要 %s MRU

message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.open.en: The portal turns green: the Gate to Hoanna is open
message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.open.zh: 传送门染成了绿色：海纳尔之门打开了

message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.fill.en: Green light fills the empty frame: the way home is mended
message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.fill.zh: 空门框里亮起了绿光：回家的门修好了

message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.wron.en: The wind cannot hear you here: gates open only in the Overworld, and only in Hoanna can an empty frame be refilled
message.essentialcraft5.wind_tablet.wron.zh: 风在这里听不见你：只有在主世界能打开海纳尔之门，只有在海纳尔能补好空门框

message.essentialcraft5.hoanna.disabled.en: The Gate to Hoanna does not respond

message.essentialcraft5.hoanna.riding.en: Dismount to pass through the gate

message.essentialcraft5.hoanna.cooldown.en: The gate needs a moment: step out and try again shortly
message.essentialcraft5.hoanna.cooldown.zh: 门还没缓过来：先走出来，过一会儿再进

message.essentialcraft5.hoanna.no_arriva.en: There is nowhere to arrive on the Hoanna side right now; try again later
message.essentialcraft5.hoanna.no_arriva.zh: 海纳尔那头暂时找不到能落脚的地方，过一会儿再试

message.essentialcraft5.hoanna.returned_.en: No Gate to Hoanna nearby, so the wind carried you back to your spawn point
message.essentialcraft5.hoanna.returned_.zh: 附近没有海纳尔之门，风把你送回了重生点

advancements.essentialcraft5.enter_hoann.en: Step through a Gate to Hoanna into the first world MRU destroyed
advancements.essentialcraft5.enter_hoann.zh: 穿过海纳尔之门，踏进第一个被 MRU 毁掉的世界
